[M] Repository Evidence and Navigation
|-- Source selection boundary: resolveDiagramSource [shared S]
|   |-- Depends on project/catalog persistence + optional CorpusAccess
|   |-- [C] Load project -> require matching projectId -> resolve diagram
|   |   |-- representationId supplied -> validate representation and revision membership
|   |   |   `-- revisionId defaults to the representation's currentRevisionId
|   |   |-- Live diagram supplied -> validate diagram and optional contentId match
|   |   |-- Otherwise, saved representation -> sceneFromRevision -> select one diagram
|   |   |   `-- Match contentId, or require exactly one diagram with a source binding
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> combine saved diagram bindings + project.sources
|   |       |-- Filter by sourceId when supplied; deduplicate by sourceId
|   |       |-- Same sourceId with conflicting root, kind or repository identity -> error
|   |       `-- Require exactly one binding -> create temporary source-query diagram
|   |-- Supplied sourceId must match the selected diagram's binding
|   `-- Exposes diagramSource query + diagram + binding() + readText() + listFiles()
|       |-- binding() rejects diagrams without a source repository
|       `-- Reads/listings -> CorpusAccess.provider(binding.corpus) [shared P]
|           `-- A project alone does not imply one repository
|-- [M] Mapping interpretation: selected diagram nodes -> source resources
|   |-- Public operations: handleNodeSelect, resolveSelectedNodes, buildSourceRangeDisplayModel
|   |-- Internal source-range index; domain handlers perform no React rendering or file I/O
|   |   |-- Reject mappings when sourceContext.contentHash != content.asciiSha256
|   |   `-- diagramSource.entries() -> mapping + entity + evidence range + binding
|   |       `-- [D] SourceRangeReference needs
|   |           |-- projectId + sourceId from entity, falling back to binding
|   |           |-- path + inclusive, one-based startLine/endLine
|   |           `-- rangeSha256 = SHA-256(originalLines joined with LF)
|   |-- [C] handleNodeSelect
|   |   `-- Sort selected nodes by diagram position -> resolveNodeResources
|   |       `-- Attach selected-node and mapped-node origins -> deduplicate resources
|   |           |-- Identity includes project, source, path, range and range hash
|   |           `-- Retain all origins plus selected/unmapped node IDs and diagram identity
|   `-- Display grouping preserves diagram order
|       |-- New section when repository/file changes or source lines move backwards
|       `-- Merge overlapping ranges within the current section; retain contributing items
|-- [M] Source application service: ProjectSourceService
|   |-- Public files(projectId, directory, sourceId?)
|   |   `-- [C] Resolve via [S] -> listFiles(directory)
|   |-- Public source(projectId, path, sourceId?)
|   |   `-- [C] Require path -> resolve via [S] -> readText(path)
|   |       |-- NUL in text -> binary-source error
|   |       `-- [D] Text -> lines + SHA-256 + path + startLine=1
|   |           `-- lspEnabled reflects whether a language service was injected
|   `-- Public definitions(reference, path, position, sourceSha256, signal)
|       |-- No injected language service -> lsp-disabled error
|       `-- [C] Resolve via [S] -> language.definitions(binding.corpus, anchor, signal) [shared L]
|-- [M] Storage adapters: corpus access and Git identity have distinct contracts
|   |-- CorpusAccess / CorpusProvider [shared P]
|   |   |-- Public: listDirectory, readLines; readable extension adds bytes/text/document lines
|   |   |-- CorpusBinding selects git-worktree or filesystem-documents provider
|   |   |   `-- Both use filesystem reads rooted at the binding's canonical directory
|   |   |-- Internal path checks
|   |   |   |-- Require relative paths; reject NUL, backslash, empty segments, '.' and '..'
|   |   |   `-- Reject symlink traversal; enforce root containment and expected file/directory type
|   |   `-- Listings hide .git and sort directories first; evidence reads validate line ranges
|   `-- GitRepositoryRegistry
|       |-- Public: list/register, resolveCheckoutRoot, resolveContext, captureHunks
|       |-- [D] Discovered Git identity -> stable repository ID + known checkout roots
|       |   |-- Initialization backfills discoverable repositories; non-Git roots stay unassigned
|       |   `-- Registration merges roots for the same repository identity
|       |-- [C] Resolve available checkout -> accept only a matching Git identity
|       |   `-- resolveContext -> resolve head, commits and optional base to commit SHAs
|       |       `-- Require repositoryId unless exactly one repository is registered
|       `-- [O] Owns persisted registry updates in project.json
|           `-- Shared per-file promise queue serializes writes; completed queue entries are removed
|-- [M] Browser access and source presentation
|   |-- CodeRepoService: explicit {projectId, sourceId} on repository operations
|   |   |-- Public: read/preload files, listDirectory, search, definitions and Git operations
|   |   |-- Positions use zero-based UTF-16; Git diff hunk lines are one-based
|   |   `-- createHttpCodeRepoService implementation
|   |       |-- File operations delegated to sourceFilesClient
|   |       |-- Directory and definition calls delegated to HTTP API helpers
|   |       `-- Search and every Git operation reject as unsupported
|   |-- [O] SourceFileCache owns shared read promises and a work queue
|   |   |-- Identity = projectId + sourceId + path; version controls reuse
|   |   |-- Compatible read -> reuse promise; on-demand access promotes queued work
|   |   |-- Reload or incompatible version -> enqueue a new read
|   |   |-- Default concurrency = 4; background reads wait behind on-demand reads
|   |   `-- Failure evicts only the matching current entry -> later reads can retry
|   `-- SourceCodePane -> CodeRepoService + SourceCodeView
|       |-- [C] File selection/reload -> readFile -> preview or retryable error
|       |-- [D] Current file hash + projected file hash -> stale decision
|       |   |-- Equal -> mapped highlights and optional compaction available
|       |   `-- Different -> show current text; disable mapped highlights and compaction
|       |-- [C] Explorer/file choice, mapped-range reveal or definition -> navigate in same pane
|       |   |-- Capture current visit -> update back/forward history -> patch pane location
|       |   `-- Reset pane scroll binding; restore destination scroll or reveal target line
|       |-- [O] Pane retains preview, history, navigation state and request controllers
|       |   |-- File-effect cleanup aborts its read; aborted results cannot update the preview
|       |   `-- New lookup/navigation, context changes and cleanup abort definition requests
|       `-- SourceCodeView renders read-only text through presentation options
|           |-- Source + path + theme -> tokenization; fall back to source text on failure
|           |-- Source ranges + compaction sections -> highlights, folds and expandable graph nodes
|           |-- [O] Owns expanded sections/nodes; ignores obsolete tokenization results
|           |-- Reads/writes bound scroll state; hidden views do not overwrite it with zero offsets
|           `-- Ctrl/Cmd+click or F12 -> source position -> pane definition callback
`-- [M] Optional definition engine: ProjectLanguageService [shared L]
    |-- Public definitions(binding, file, position, sourceSha256, signal) and dispose()
    |-- [C] Validate supported TS/JS path and nonnegative integer UTF-16 position
    |   `-- Read current text through [P] -> compare SHA-256 -> validate position within text
    |       |-- Hash mismatch -> require reload before definition lookup
    |       `-- Canonicalize root -> obtain/create LanguageSession -> queued lookup
    |           `-- Wait for initialization -> didOpen(text) -> textDocument/definition -> didClose
    |-- [D] Definition result depends on current text + matching hash + position + language response
    |   |-- Normalize locations/links; retain repository-relative file targets
    |   `-- Deduplicate locations and count excluded targets as outsideRoot
    |       `-- Pane: one result -> navigate; multiple -> chooser; none -> explanatory message
    `-- [O] One lazy session per canonical root, shared across panes
        |-- Internal LanguageSession owns child process, JSON-RPC connection, queue and timers
        |-- Initialization requires definition support and UTF-16; workspace edits are refused
        |-- Requests run serially; AbortSignal cancels the active RPC request
        |-- Initialization/definition timeout: 20 seconds -> dispose session
        |-- Idle timeout: 5 minutes; child/RPC failure also disposes session
        `-- Service disposal or process shutdown -> dispose RPC and terminate child process
            `-- A later lookup replaces a dead session while the service remains active
